title: Debian package (.deb) signature
summary: A .deb package is an ar archive containing three files: debian-binary (version string), control.tar.gz (package metadata), and data.tar.gz (package files). The ar archive begins with '!<arch>\n' (0x21 0x3C 0x61 0x72 0x63 0x68 0x3E 0x0A).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: .deb is an ar archive with debian-binary, control.tar.gz, data.tar.gz.
Used by Debian, Ubuntu, and derivatives.
dpkg is the package manager for .deb files.
